BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry Property Sales and Letting Agents are delighted to present this 3-bedroom mid-terrace bungalow onto the market for sale.

This well-located property offers spacious accommodation throughout and is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, those looking to downsize, or anyone seeking a home in a mature and convenient residential area close to Drogheda town centre.

Accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, a large open-plan kitchen/dining/living area, three bedrooms, an ensuite and a separate WC. The property also benefits from gas-fired central heating, double-glazed windows and new flooring throughout.

To the rear, there is an enclosed yard providing a private and low-maintenance outdoor space.

The location is exceptionally convenient, with Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital within walking distance and a wide range of local amenities close at hand, including schools, shops, sporting facilities and public transport services. Drogheda town centre is just minutes away, while the M1 motorway offers easy access to Dublin, Belfast and beyond.

Offering generous living accommodation in an established residential location, this property presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to purchase a home with all conceivable amenities on their doorstep.

Viewing is highly recommended.

Features

3-bedroom mid-terrace bungalow
Large open-plan kitchen/dining/living area
Ensuite and separate WC
Gas-fired central heating
Double-glazed windows
New flooring throughout
Enclosed rear yard
Walking distance to Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital
Close to schools, shops and public transport
Easy access to the M1 motorway
Established residential location
Ideal first-time buyer or downsizer property
